defs.def: to send out programmes on television or radio 播送（电视或无线电节目）；广播

ex.s: Cookery shows and documentaries about food are broadcast more often than before.
ex.t: 关于食物的烹饪节目和纪录片比以往播出得更频繁。

ex.s: From broadcasting to street art, these are just 4 of the 17 highly unique camps being offered.
ex.t: 从广播到街头艺术，这些只是所开设的17个极具特色的营会中的4个。

ex.s: While running every aspect of our own news station, kids and their fellow campers will create and host a broadcast airing each night at dinner for the entire camp.
ex.t: 在运营我们自己新闻台的方方面面时，孩子们和营友将创作并主持一档每晚晚餐时向全营播出的节目。

ex.s: What will campers do at the Broadcasting Camp?
ex.t: 营员们会在广播营里做什么？

ex.s: By the way, if you have enjoyed this live broadcast, subscribe to find out where I’m visiting next!
ex.t: 顺便说一句，如果你喜欢这场直播，请订阅以了解我下一站去哪里！

ex.s: Background information Ugly Betty is an American television series, originally broadcast on ABC from 2006 to 2010.
ex.t: 背景信息　《丑女贝蒂》是一部美国电视连续剧，最初于2006至2010年在ABC播出。

ex.s: This broadcast is being brought to you from the largest museum on Earth -- the Louvre!
ex.t: 本次直播来自地球上最大的博物馆——卢浮宫！

ex.s: Louvre art Mona Lisa exhibition museum selfie fantastic tour guide history live broadcast Winged Victory of Samothrace Here at the top of the stairs is this 1________.
ex.t: 卢浮宫　艺术　蒙娜丽莎　展览　博物馆　自拍　绝佳的　导游　历史　直播　《萨莫色雷斯的胜利女神》　在楼梯顶端的是这1____。

ex.s: In fact, news reports are frequently broadcast about extreme rainstorms and heatwaves causing deaths and economic losses.
ex.t: 事实上，关于极端暴雨和热浪造成死亡与经济损失的报道频频播出。

defs.def: to tell a lot of people about sth 散布，传播（信息等）
